description: Defines the TensorOptions class and related functions for configuring tensor properties in PyTorch's C++ API, including constructors, property accessors, and dispatch key computations.

classes.name: TensorOptions
classes.description: A class to encapsulate tensor construction options such as dtype, device, layout, requires_grad, pinned_memory, and memory_format, with methods for constructing, merging, and querying these options.

methods.name: dtype_or_default
methods.description: Returns the scalar type from an optional, or the default scalar type if not specified.

methods.name: dtype_or_default
methods.description: Returns the TypeMeta from an optional, or the default TypeMeta if not specified.

methods.name: layout_or_default
methods.description: Returns the layout from an optional, or the default layout if not specified.

methods.name: device_or_default
methods.description: Returns the device from an optional, or the default CPU device if not specified.

methods.name: pinned_memory_or_default
methods.description: Returns the pinned memory flag from an optional, or false if not specified.

methods.name: computeDispatchKey
methods.description: Computes the dispatch key based on optional dtype, layout, and device.
